verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships interactive tools such as the Playground, Node Material Editor and Inspector, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions an AI assistant or any task delegation in those tools or in the engine. The llms.txt files are documentation aimed at external LLMs, not an in-product assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
